purpose: Prepare one bounded, source-grounded bilingual adapter experiment whose complete-document result must improve against the same unadapted trainable base. No training was performed or authorized.

unchanged_time_budget.total_includes: All in-run baseline inference, data/template/mask checks, model/adapter load, optimizer work, adapter inference, scoring and persistence/verification; not optimizer-only time. No hidden extra evaluation window.
unchanged_time_budget.launch_precondition: Before future execution approval, establish a bounded task/output workload and conservative host-specific feasibility for the entire paired comparison/state preservation within1800seconds. Performance not established in this campaign.
unchanged_time_budget.reserve_requirement: Pre-authorized bounded optimizer start cutoff must leave measured/conservatively bounded time for adapter evaluation and state preservation. If no defensible reserve exists, do not update.
unchanged_time_budget.timeout_policy: Any incomplete baseline, post-adapter output, scoring or preservation yields INCOMPLETE/NO_GO, never a complete-acceptance improvement. No retry, task shrink, higher caps or budget widening without separate authorization.
unchanged_time_budget.not_verified: Native training/inference throughput, memory peak, checkpoint costs and total runtime

supervised_data_contract.initial_owner_review_floor_historical: Four bilingual task pairs, not an approved split or current training dataset.
required_manifest_fields: stable task and bilingual target identity
owner Gold approval and separate rights/confidentiality decision
family-group split excluding evaluation tasks/translations/revisions/derived FAQs/shared-target leakage
actual tokenizer/template/rendered prompt/full sequence IDs and mask evidence
supervised_data_contract.future_target_format: Must be pinned to the actual approved trainer and rendered supervised sequence. Template records or a mask_prompt switch alone are insufficient.
required_mask_checks: Prompt token IDs exactly equal the full sequence prefix where the selected trainer requires it.
At least one real nonpadding target token; all intended complete target tokens supervised.
No prompt or padding positions accidentally included in target loss.
Exact BOS/EOS/stop and pad behavior on the actual candidate tokenizer and loader.
No silent truncation, bilingual target shortening, task narrowing or sequence-cap increase to force admission.
Sequence512 remains a historical unvalidated proposal; sample fit must be measured before executable authorization.

requirements: Approve exact immutable trainable checkpoint/tensor/dtype/quantization identities; GGUF versus MLX metadata is not equivalent loaded base evidence.
Approve exact full tokenizer, template and native loader; matching selected special tokens is insufficient.
Verify a compatible authorized Apple Silicon MLX/MLX-LM environment and measured peak/all-stage feasibility.
Validate the actual last-two-layer Q/V module inventory and A/B shapes, scale convention and frozen/trainable flags.
No package installation, new weights, optimizer or adapters until a separately approved executable pilot exists.

independent_evaluation_contract.required: Freeze task sources, family exclusions, expected outcomes, complete bilingual requirements and all gates before any pilot model output; evaluate the same completed task set for the same unadapted trainable base and its adapter.

primary_success.primary: At least one complete frozen held-out documentation/FAQ task passes all applicable predeclared dimensions, and adapted accepted-task count strictly exceeds matched unadapted count on exactly the same completed task set.
primary_success.critical_guard: Any critical unsupported guarantee, false removal, private/right violation or false source approval disqualifies success; do not trade critical errors against acceptance count.
primary_success.nonregression: Identifier preservation, EN/PT coverage, per-claim support and warranted abstention must not regress under the frozen denominators. Report all paired outcomes and rejected/truncated/incomplete records.
primary_success.tie_or_baseline_ceiling: Tie in complete acceptance is not demonstrated learning. If baseline accepts all, use only a separately pre-frozen meaningful improvement criterion or report inconclusive; never change it after observing results.
primary_success.tiny_sample_limit: Feasibility evidence only, not general accuracy, independent truth verification or evidence of reliable full architectural documentation.

critical_disqualification: Any unsupported runtime or ownership guarantee
Any private/rights violation or source approval inferred from model-authored scope metadata
Any incomplete paired output, scoring or state preservation
independent_evaluation_contract.new_metadata_pair_scope: The prepared two-arm DEV metadata-placement requests are unadapted inference preparation only, not the matched baseline-versus-adapter evaluation.

required_saved_state: adapter trainable parameters and exact module inventory
training data cursor/order and iteration/accumulation state
all outputs, metrics, failures, timestamps and actual elapsed budgets
state_and_rollback_contract.required_validation: Prove exact state binding and bounded restoration/resumption/rollback in the approved compatible runtime. Adapter-only load into a newly initialized optimizer is not full resume.
state_and_rollback_contract.stop_rule: If state preservation or paired evaluation cannot fit the total 1800-second budget, do not update; any incomplete result is NO_GO/INCOMPLETE.

future_owner_decisions_after_technical_p: Approve exact Gold targets, rights and family-grouped evaluation manifests.
Approve exact trainable base/tokenizer/template/environment and loaded module inventory.
Approve the fully measured executable workload, masks, state protocol, memory/time bounds and rollback.
Authorize that one executable pilot explicitly; this package does not authorize it.
safe_unattended_fallback: Preserve all evidence and continue independent documentation/evaluation research; do not bypass runtime denial or ask mid-campaign questions.
scope_limits: Not a training configuration, implementation prompt, adapter artifact or approval request during this campaign.
All historical numeric hyperparameters remain unvalidated design choices.
Owner review of this package is distinct from permission to execute training.
